bangladesh.title: Flag of the People's Republic of Bangladesh

colors.officialSpec: Procion Brilliant Green H-2RS 50 parts per 1000
colors.note: The green field stands for the lushness of the land of Bangladesh and the eternal youth of Bangladeshis.
The red disc represents the sun rising over Bengal, and also the blood of those who died for the independence of Bangladesh.

desc:
- The flag of Bangladesh features a dark green field with a red circle offset slightly toward the hoist
- The green represents the lush vegetation and vitality of the land, while the red disc symbolises the rising sun
- and the blood shed during the 1971 Liberation War. The disc is offset so it appears centred when the flag is flying
- Designed by Quamrul Hassan, it was first hoisted on 2 March 1971
trivia:
- The red disc is deliberately offset toward the hoist so it appears centred when the flag flies in the wind
- The green represents the lush landscape and hope; red represents blood shed during independence
- Adopted in 1971 during the Bangladesh Liberation War; one of the newest national flags (tied with 5 others for 1971)

bangladesh-navy.title: Naval Ensign of Bangladesh

colors.note: The blood shed during the 1971 Liberation War.

desc:
- The ensign of the Bangladesh Navy is a white field with a green and red canton (matching the national flag) in the upper hoist, plus a fouled anchor
- Adopted after independence in 1971, the naval ensign reflects Bangladesh's strategic location on the Bay of Bengal and its maritime tradition
- **Construction:** white field with a green canton containing a red disc
- A navy anchor and other naval insignia appear on the fly side
- Ratio approximately 1:2
trivia:
- The naval ensign includes naval heraldic symbols
- Represents Bangladesh's maritime defense and naval power
- Uses traditional naval flag conventions
